purpose: Teach: アンプ/エンタープライズ/タイムズ/バーツ/カンパニー/キーパー/エコノミスト/ウィルコム

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験室のアンプ、つまり信号増幅器の仕様を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren, check the specifications on the lab amplifier—the signal amplifier in the equipment room.
lines.style: Direct, measured delivery. Crisp on the task name. No waste. The tone of someone who trusts you to execute. Brief eye contact, then moving on.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。エンタープライズ向け技術の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the technical papers on enterprise-level equipment.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment. Slight nod implied in the voice. Earnest but not overeager—he's registering the task, already thinking through it. Small breath between lines.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、フィナンシャル・タイムズの記事を読んで業界動向を掴め
lines.en: Ren, read the Financial Times article and get a handle on industry trends.
lines.style: Clear, instructional. Slight emphasis on the publication name. Expects understanding. No inflection that softens it—this is work. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。アジア通貨、つまりバーツの研究も視野に入れます
lines.en: Yes. I'll also look into Asian currency research—the Thai baht specifically.
lines.style: Thoughtful addition to the task. Not defensive, but showing he's already thinking sideways. Slight pause before the baht mention—he's adding value, not just repeating orders. Careful enunciation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外カンパニーの研究所を取材しろ
lines.en: Ren, go interview the research facilities at overseas companies.
lines.style: Command-level clarity. Slight weight on 'overseas'—this is a bigger ask. Still composed, still brief. The tone of someone delegating real responsibility.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験データのキーパー、つまり管理担当を引き受けます
lines.en: Yes. I'll take on managing the experimental data—keeping the records organized.
lines.style: Formal and steady. He's accepting a larger responsibility. Slight formality in his acceptance—this matters. No hesitation, but gravitas underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、エコノミスト誌の経済分析を毎週読め
lines.en: Ren, read the Economist's economic analysis every week.
lines.style: Final directive of the sequence. Calm, almost matter-of-fact. The word 'every week' lands without emphasis but with weight. He's setting a rhythm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の旧ウィルコム端末の処分を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll also handle disposing of the old WILLCOM phones in the lab.
lines.style: Closing acceptance. Ren's showing he's thinking beyond the main tasks—managing the practical details too. Quiet, efficient. A small pride in thoroughness underneath the politeness.
